phase_name: push.py phase-token regex two-letter suffix truncation repair
summary: Small, dedicated repair discovered and independently demonstrated live while finalizing Phase 137MV: pcae push falsely reported phase_report_identity: failed for a legitimately matching 137MV report/task pair, blocking push. Root-caused to src/pcae/commands/push.py's _PHASE_TOKEN_RE, a second, independent occurrence of the unquantified-[A-Za-z] defect class already logged in tasks/TODO.md for a different file (src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py:3044). The 137F.1V fix to this same regex quantified the dotted-segment letter suffix but left the first, non-dotted letter-suffix group unquantified (exactly one letter), so a two-letter, non-dotted suffix like 137MV truncated to 137M. Fixed by quantifying [A-Za-z] to [A-Za-z]* (zero or more), matching phase_reports.py's own already-corrected convention. Independently reproduced the bug via direct regex execution before and after the fix. Added a fresh regression test, test_137mv1_phase_token_regex_does_not_truncate_two_letter_undotted_suffix, distinct from the existing 137F.1V dotted-suffix fixture. Logged the still-open sibling bug in repository_transition_integration.py's parse_phase_id_from_text() (same defect, different file, not fixed here) in tasks/TODO.md. See docs/PHASE_137MV_TAMPC_SIGNATURE_AMBIGUITY_CONTRACT_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md for the 137MV verification this repair unblocked the finalization of.
tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py::test_137mv1_phase_token_regex_does_not_truncate_two_letter_undotted_suffix -- new regression test asserting a two-letter, non-dotted phase-ID suffix (137LMV) is not truncated and does not falsely block push.
